title: Integrating Conversational AI Roleplaying Chat Bot With Twitch Chat
author: Optimeyez007
selftext:
Hi everyone, I'm working on a conversational AI chatbot. An idea we have is to integrate this AI into the chat of a streaming platform, allowing viewers to shape stories in real-time, much like "Twitch Plays Pokémon," but with narratives generated by the AI. We want to hire a streamer, and the streamer would then bring these stories to life through improv acting. Though given the somewhat new territory, there are a lot of things to figure out, and experimenting is needed. I'm seeking any thoughts, insight or advice on this

Thanks
